description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 (Special Commodity Levy of Eggs)
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing and modifying a special commodity levy on imported eggs. It involves regulatory matters, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements related to taxation and import regulations, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would make it a government-related type.
